list.offDescription: Sponsored products: reach more buyers, pay only for real clicks.
list.offComingSoonDesc: Advertising is not switched on yet. When it is, you will pay a fixed, public price per click, your ads will always be labelled Sponsored, and paying will never change your verification badge or normal search position.
list.description: Sponsored products. A fixed public price per click, you set a daily budget, and you never pay for invalid clicks.
list.walletHint: Separate from your lead credits. Ads pause when it is empty.
list.walletEmpty: Your ad wallet is empty, so your campaigns are not running. During the pilot, our finance team adds funds after a bank transfer: contact support with your business name. Online top-up is coming.
list.noCampaignsDesc: Create your first campaign in a few minutes. Start with a small daily budget; you can pause any time.
list.statusNote: Campaign status reasons appear on each campaign page.
list.ratesCaption: Fixed price per click by category and placement
list.ratesNone: Prices have not been published yet.
list.ratesNote: There is no bidding: everyone pays the same price, so paying more does not rank you higher. Ads need a verified business. Prices exclude GST.
list.ratesNoteCfg: There is no bidding: everyone pays the same price, so paying more does not rank you higher. Ads need a verified business (tier {tier} or higher) with a trust score of at least {floor}. Prices exclude GST.
list.walletFooter: Paid balance never expires and can be refunded on request. Promo credit expires after 90 days. Auto top-up is off and will only be switched on by you, with a cap.

detail.runs: Runs from {start} until you pause it.
detail.rejected: Not approved: {reason}. Fix the items below and send it for review again.
detail.suspendedContact: Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
detail.pendingReview: In review. Our team usually replies within one business day. New keywords and products are reviewed one by one, so one issue does not stop the rest.
detail.whyNotShown: Why you are not shown more
detail.lostShare: Share of chances you missed: {budget} because the daily budget ran out (raise the budget), {quality} because other ads matched better or you hit the frequency limit (improve product photos, titles and your trust score).
detail.selfClicks: {count, plural, one {# click came from your own team.} other {# clicks came from your own team.}} They are never charged; please do not click your own ads.
detail.noEdit: This campaign can no longer be edited.

kpi.costPerEnquiryHint: {count, plural, one {# enquiry after an ad click, within 7 days} other {# enquiries after an ad click, within 7 days}}
kpi.note: Reporting is not real time. Impressions update hourly and clicks are re-checked for up to 72 hours, so recent numbers can still change.

form.intro: Set a budget, choose products and keywords, and send it for review. You are charged only for real clicks.
form.name: Campaign name
form.orEnter: Or enter an amount (₹ per day)
form.minHint: Minimum ₹{min}. We never charge more than this in a day, even if more buyers click.
form.endHint: Leave empty to run until you pause it.
form.productsIntro: Only your published, approved products with an approved photo can run. Your product card is the ad: no custom text, so nothing can be misleading.
form.notRunUntilFixed: {note} It will not run until this is fixed.
form.noProducts: You have no products yet. Publish a product first.
form.keywordsHint: One per line. Add [exact], [phrase] or [broad] at the end to set the match (default phrase). Start a line with - for words that must never trigger your ad. Our team reviews every keyword; brand names you do not own are not approved.
form.statesHint: Leave empty for all of India. Type one state, e.g. Gujarat.
form.pincodesHint: First 3 digits, separated by commas, e.g. 560, 380.
form.cpcUnset: Set by category, shown after review
form.maxDay: Most you can spend in a day
form.maxClicks: Clicks that budget buys, at most
form.t1: You pay only when a real buyer clicks. Invalid clicks (bots, repeats, your own team) are free, and refunded automatically if found later.
form.t2: Paying does not change your verification badge or your normal search position. Your ad is always labelled "Sponsored".
form.t3: Our team reviews new campaigns, usually within one business day. If an enquiry from an ad becomes a lead you accept, the normal lead credit applies as well.
form.t4: No commitment: pause or end at any time.

controls.confirmEnd: End this campaign for good? You can create a new one any time. Nothing more is charged.
controls.budgetHint: Raising it above double sends the campaign back for review.
controls.addKeywordsHint: One per line. New keywords are reviewed before they run; existing ones keep running.
controls.added: Added. They will run once approved.
